newsitem.title: USA: Southern Mineral has private placement.
newsitem.headline: Southern Mineral has private placement.

text.p: Southern Mineral Corp Monday said it privately placed 2.5 million shares of common stock at $4.50 a share to institutional investors.

After the closing, the company will register the shares in a shelf registration filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission. Proceeds from the about $10.6 million offering, after expenses, will be used to reduce bank debt, fudn the cost of future exploration and devlopment projects and provide additional working capital for general corporate purposes.
Morgan Keegan & Co acted as a placement agent for the company n the issuance of the shares.
